canonical_project: Pioneer Park Clean Energy and AI Data Centre Campus
owner: BEC / Energy Coast West Cumbria Ltd; Cumberland Council; Nuclear Decommissioning Authority

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: BEC's Pioneer Park master-planning tender/prospectus describes land near Sellafield in West Cumbria being explored for clean energy development and AI/data centre infrastructure, including direct-line power supply to AI data centre facilities by 2030. NDA announced funding for a masterplan examining how clean energy and AI/data centre infrastructure could come together. No firm data-centre MW allocation found.
